HireScope Responsibility: Own settings/version model, Owner-only administration, default inheritance, change history, and prevention of retroactive changes to active applicant stages.

Feature: Configure assessment and interview delivery policy
What it does: The Pente Organisation Owner enables the permitted assessment/interview modes, readiness and consent requirements, audio recording rules, retry limits, accommodation defaults, and live-interview panel rules. Video assessment/interview recording is explicitly unavailable in this scope.
How it maps to Steward: HireScope-owned:
HireScope Responsibility: Own Owner-only settings, versioning, opening inheritance, consent policy, and hard disablement of video configuration.
Dependencies: Fixed Pente owner; assessment configuration; privacy policy

What it does: Ensures every read and mutation is scoped to Pente and unauthorised/cross-context access is denied and audited; no multi-business selection is offered in this release.
Steward Capability: Authenticated member identity and module roles

HireScope Responsibility: Enforce the fixed Pente scope and object relationships in every API/query; append denial audit.

What it does: Recognises authorised Organisation Admin, HR, Hiring Manager, and Interviewer access without recreating Steward role management.

HireScope Responsibility: Map Steward role identifiers to HireScope permissions and job-opening assignments; keep workflow assignments separate.

Feature: Read staff, units, and reporting lines

How it maps to Steward: Query on demand or maintain a minimal event-driven projection; do not treat copied directory fields as independent master data.
HireScope Responsibility: Use the returned people only where recruitment requires them; constrain results to authorised tenant/workflow context.

What it does: The Pente Organisation Admin views member status and maintains active/inactive recruitment membership, including a reasoned deactivation/reinstatement. The admin cannot change Organisation Owner settings or make candidate decisions.
Steward Capability: listPeople; listModuleRoles; role.changed; module_roles.changed; exact member-write operation needs confirmation
How it maps to Steward: Use Steward member access and role lifecycle; reflect role.changed rather than maintaining staff accounts in HireScope.
HireScope Responsibility: Own HireScope staff-to-workflow references, job-specific access effects, deactivation consequences, and audit projection.
Dependencies: Fixed Pente Organisation Admin; Steward member-management contract; audit

Feature: Approve or revoke recruitment role access
What it does: The Pente Organisation Admin approves/rejects authorised HR or Hiring Manager access requests and revokes organisation-level recruitment access with a reason; job-specific interviewer access remains created only by the approved opening/panel workflow.
Steward Capability: listModuleRoles; role.changed; askPerson; exact role-grant/revoke operation needs confirmation
How it maps to Steward: Use Steward owner/admin and module-role controls for recruitment access; route access review to a Steward task.
HireScope Responsibility: Own the access-request record, evidence, decision UI, workflow-scope validation, revocation impact, and audit history.
Dependencies: Pente member; Steward role-grant contract; job-opening assignment rules

Feature: Configure retention, legal hold, and audit policy
What it does: Defines retention rules and legal holds for recruitment records; holds override scheduled deletion.
How it maps to Steward: Use createAudit, fileRecord for signed artefacts, and createDeletionReceipt at verified purge; HireScope retains its policy schedule.
HireScope Responsibility: Own record retention schedule, legal-hold access restrictions, purge jobs, and domain audit events.

What it does: Captures workforce need, headcount, job information, criteria, stages, sections, questions, and weights.
How it maps to Steward: HireScope-owned:

What it does: Locks the submitted version and routes it to HR for review without changing the underlying approved version.

HireScope Responsibility: Create immutable submission version, approval queue, SLA, and transition history.

What it does: HR approves, returns with reason, or the authorised creator withdraws; returned resubmissions create a new version.
How it maps to Steward: Use a Steward HR approval task/proposal for approve, return, or withdrawal; apply the decision in HireScope after acceptance.
HireScope Responsibility: Enforce lifecycle transitions, immutable reviews, return/resubmission and creator-only withdrawal rules.

What it does: Drafts and edits the fair-pack/evidence areas, questions, stages, timing, attempts, modalities, and weights before approval.
Steward Capability: completeAi may be used for advisory drafting
How it maps to Steward: HireScope-owned: If AI drafting is enabled, call the metered Steward AI gateway; no AI output can decide a candidate or bypass review.
HireScope Responsibility: Own prompts/configuration, human edits, versioning, validation, and approved configuration lock.
Dependencies: AI gateway; requisition configuration; HR approval

What it does: Creates an opening only from an approved requisition and carries forward its approved configuration.
How it maps to Steward: HireScope-owned:
HireScope Responsibility: Own opening draft/version, requisition linkage, operational posting fields, target capacity, and inherited configuration.

What it does: Selects eligible employees for a specific opening/stage panel rather than granting broad interviewer access.
How it maps to Steward: Read eligible staff and reporting lines from Steward, then create assignment-scoped interviewer tasks after approval.
HireScope Responsibility: Persist nominations, conflict/eligibility checks, stage scope, and HR approval requirement.
Dependencies: Opening draft; staff directory; HR review

Feature: Approve or return opening and panel package
What it does: HR reviews the opening configuration and nominated panels; return requires correction and resubmission.
How it maps to Steward: Route the HR approval/return work through a Steward task or proposal and update the opening only after its decision.
HireScope Responsibility: Enforce HR decision, immutable review history, return/resubmission, and the approved-to-publish gate.
Dependencies: Opening version; panel nominations; HR authorization

What it does: After package approval, creates a restricted stage assignment and sends an invitation; expiry/replacement remains visible.
How it maps to Steward: Create a Steward task for the appointed interviewer. Send every staff email as a Steward notice or approved createMessage draft.
HireScope Responsibility: Own invitation record, 24-hour activation status, stage access, replacement flow, and audit trail.
Dependencies: Approved panel; Steward role/invitation contract; notification outbox

What it does: The opening creator publishes the HR-approved version to the configured channels; publication activates candidate intake.
How it maps to Steward: HireScope-owned: Optionally publish an internal board announcement; no public job-board posting connector is evidenced.
HireScope Responsibility: Enforce creator-only publish, state transition, channel publication integrations, public opening page, and audit.

What it does: HR raises a controlled request and only the creating Hiring Manager executes or rejects it with a reason.
How it maps to Steward: Assign the controlled opening action to the responsible creator in Steward and use task status to track completion.
HireScope Responsibility: Own action-request state, execution authority, opening lifecycle, reason, and downstream applicant effects.
Dependencies: Opening; HR and creator roles; audit

What it does: Shows only published active openings and candidate-safe job details.
How it maps to Steward: HireScope-owned: No public vacancy discovery capability is evidenced.
HireScope Responsibility: Own public search/detail endpoints, opening visibility, accessibility, and closing/suspension behavior.

Feature: Create or select applicant workspace context
What it does: Associates an applicant with the selected organisation/opening while keeping applicant profile, application, and employee membership distinct.
Steward Capability: Steward authenticated identity/session; guest-key capability requires verification
How it maps to Steward: Use Steward's external applicant sign-in client or approved guest-key model; keep applicant scope separate from staff access.
HireScope Responsibility: Own applicant profile/application separation, tenant scoping, opening eligibility, and applicant-safe access.

What it does: Captures the version-pinned intake form, candidate details, resume/documents, and consent.
Steward Capability: fileRecord may seal final legal artefacts, not intake storage
How it maps to Steward: HireScope-owned: Keep candidate documents in HireScope-authorised storage; use fileRecord only if legal policy calls for a sealed artefact.
HireScope Responsibility: Own application form/version, duplicate checks, document access control, consent, and application creation.

What it does: Parses resume content into role-relevant facts for advisory review without using protected/context-only data as a score.
Steward Capability: completeAi; sendOutside for approved parser provider
How it maps to Steward: Use completeAi for permitted advisory extraction and sendOutside only for an approved parser; HireScope retains the evidence.
HireScope Responsibility: Own parser orchestration, evidence model, confidence/failure handling, human review, and privacy controls.

What it does: Flags possible duplicate profiles or applications for controlled HR resolution without silently merging records.
How it maps to Steward: HireScope-owned:
HireScope Responsibility: Own matching rules, HR resolution UI, merge/link audit, and privacy-safe candidate communication.

What it does: Compares submitted evidence to configured criteria and records advisory flags; AI never qualifies, rejects, advances, or selects.
How it maps to Steward: Use completeAi through Steward's metered AI gateway for advisory relevance output; it cannot change applicant state.
HireScope Responsibility: Own rule boundary, immutable AI result, evidence references, confidence, review queue, and failure retry.

What it does: HR reviews resume and AI evidence and records qualified, pending, or not-currently-qualified outcome with required human rationale.
How it maps to Steward: Assign the HR pre-screen review in Steward. Draft any applicant-facing email with createMessage and treat it as sent only after getMessage confirms it.
HireScope Responsibility: Own decision batches, internal note versus applicant-visible status, progression, and access restrictions.
Dependencies: AI evidence; HR authority; notification outbox

What it does: Invites the qualified candidate with start/deadline/duration, instructions, and a version-pinned assessment.
Steward Capability: createMessage; notifyGuest only if guest model is confirmed
How it maps to Steward: Draft the assessment invitation with createMessage in Steward Out-Tray; use getMessage for awaiting-approval, sent, or discarded status.
HireScope Responsibility: Own invitation state, attempt entitlement, time controls, version pinning, and delivery outbox/retry.
Dependencies: HR decision; assessment config; communications contract

What it does: Checks camera/microphone/connectivity where required, captures informed consent, and provides accessibility/accommodation path before attempt start.
How it maps to Steward: HireScope-owned: No consent/readiness API is evidenced.
HireScope Responsibility: Own consent record, readiness checks, candidate instructions, accessibility-safe states, and attempt-start gate.

What it does: Lets candidate request an equivalent alternative; HR sees details, while interviewers receive only needed operational instructions.
Steward Capability: askPerson or createProposal can support HR review; createAudit
How it maps to Steward: Assign the HR accommodation decision as a private Steward task or structured ask, limiting sensitive details to authorised reviewers.
HireScope Responsibility: Own accommodation record, least-privilege projection, decision, configured equivalent path, and audit.

Feature: Treat an unattempted assessment as withdrawal
What it does: When an invited applicant does not attend or submit the assessment by the configured deadline and submits no in-product grievance within 24 hours, HireScope treats the application as withdrawn, releases any unfilled reservation, and records an applicant-safe outcome. No automatic progression or reopening occurs.
How it maps to Steward: HireScope-owned: Append governance audit and stage the applicant-visible outcome message through the approved communications path where applicable.
HireScope Responsibility: Own deadline job, attendance/submission check, 24-hour grievance window, withdrawal state, reservation release, and immutable evidence trail.
Dependencies: Assessment invitation; assessment attempt; grievance window; capacity transaction

What it does: After withdrawal, HR reviews a timely grievance or other recorded explanation such as a phone call or email. HR may approve a six-month retest eligibility date; this creates a later linked replacement application for an eligible open position and never reopens the original application.
How it maps to Steward: Assign HR's retest-eligibility review in Steward and send the resulting applicant notice through Steward after the decision.
HireScope Responsibility: Own evidence reference, HR decision, `retest_eligible_at`, duplicate/position checks, linked replacement application, and access controls.
Dependencies: Withdrawn assessment; HR authority; evidence record; open position

What it does: Delivers version-pinned work sample, reading/spoken items, structured questions, timing, attempts, and required sections.
How it maps to Steward: HireScope-owned: No assessment delivery capability is evidenced.
HireScope Responsibility: Own attempt creation, timer, section/item rendering, response capture, and immutable version references.

What it does: Captures each answer and media version within permitted retry rules; final submission is immutable.
Steward Capability: sendOutside may relay approved media/transcription service
How it maps to Steward: HireScope-owned: Use relay only for an approved external processor; HireScope remains system of record for submission and media metadata.
HireScope Responsibility: Own response/media records, upload security, retry limits, final lock, and audit.

What it does: Lets candidate report a technical interruption or grievance within the configured window; locks affected attempt for HR review.
How it maps to Steward: Create a private HR review task for the grievance and use Steward audit/message primitives for the reviewed outcome.
HireScope Responsibility: Own grievance policy/window, evidence, locked state, HR decision, reattempt and applicant message.

What it does: Compares permitted speech baselines for advisory integrity flagging; cannot auto-fail or decide progression.
How it maps to Steward: HireScope-owned: Use approved AI/service relay where needed; retain provider failure/correlation data.
HireScope Responsibility: Own consent gate, limited-purpose analysis, flag/result immutability, human review, and deletion schedule.

What it does: Marks completion state, prevents edits, and makes the packet available for authorised review without auto-progression.
How it maps to Steward: HireScope-owned: No assessment state capability is evidenced.
HireScope Responsibility: Own completion rules, immutable final submission, status, audit, and HR queue projection.

Feature: Advance, hold, reject, or invite next stage

What it does: Gives each interviewer only authorised candidate information, schedule, prior applicant-visible HR messages, and scoring criteria.
How it maps to Steward: Use a Steward task linked to the opening/stage so the interviewer receives the assignment and its status is tracked centrally.
HireScope Responsibility: Own least-privilege data projection, stage assignment check, and access audit.

What it does: Captures each interviewer's independent section-level score/comments and locks it after submission.
How it maps to Steward: HireScope-owned: Append immutable submission metadata to Steward audit if governance policy requires it.
HireScope Responsibility: Own scorecard, validation, immutability, deadline, and separation from peer evaluations/HR decision.

What it does: Shows completion status but never another interviewer's score/comments; hands completed set to HR.

HireScope Responsibility: Own completion aggregation without composite decision, HR handoff state, and deadline/escalation logic.

HireScope Responsibility: Own reason, new assignment/attempt, immutable history, confidential retake note, SLA escalation, and applicant message.

What it does: Records human final disposition after configured HR interview; selection reserves capacity atomically but does not itself fill a position.
How it maps to Steward: Assign the final HR selection decision in Steward; HireScope applies the accepted decision and reservation transaction.
HireScope Responsibility: Own final decision, selection record, capacity reservation, internal/applicant messages, and audit.

HireScope Responsibility: Own offer data/template, human review/approval policy, versioning, expiry, candidate link, and access controls.

HireScope Responsibility: Own outcome state, atomic reservation release, onboarding trigger, and closure/suspension rules.

How it maps to Steward: On accepted offer, create delegated onboarding tasks in Steward and link them to the HireScope onboarding case.
HireScope Responsibility: Own onboarding record, one-case invariant, external reference, capacity reservation continuity, and applicant-visible status.

HireScope Responsibility: Own onboarding-case context, task-to-case links, completion gate, external handoff, and access rules.

HireScope Responsibility: Own onboarding task, requested account attributes, activation status reference, and exception trail.

HireScope Responsibility: Own onboarding status transition, capacity transaction, fill creation, application closure/suspension, and notification outbox.

HireScope Responsibility: Own the scoped employee profile, source-onboarding link, uniqueness check, creation audit, and document references.

HireScope Responsibility: Own fields explicitly approved for current scope, validation, provenance, change history, and access control; define source-of-truth field map before build.
Dependencies: Employee profile; HR policy; data ownership decision

What it does: Associates verified onboarding/employment document records with the employee profile and records history.
How it maps to Steward: Use fileRecord for signed employment artefacts and createDeletionReceipt at purge; HireScope maintains approved document references.
HireScope Responsibility: Own document metadata/access policy, link to employee record, retention/legal-hold enforcement, and audit.
Dependencies: Employee record; document storage; legal policy

Feature: Maintain reserved, filled, and available capacity

How it maps to Steward: HireScope-owned: No recruitment-capacity capability is evidenced.
HireScope Responsibility: Own row-locked/transactional capacity logic, selection reservation, release triggers, and audit.

HireScope Responsibility: Own position-fill record, auto-close rule, opening/application transitions, and read-only historical opening.

Feature: Retain, export, legal-hold, and delete records

HireScope Responsibility: Own post-closure ACL projection, server-side redaction, access-log events, legal-hold override, and retention deletion transition.
Dependencies: Closed opening; retention/legal hold; actor role and opening assignment

HireScope Responsibility: Own operational reporting model, fair-use metrics, report authorization, and exports.
Dependencies: Domain event data; source health; audit policy

HireScope Responsibility: Own workflow retry policy, idempotency, failure UI, recovery authorisation, and preserved domain evidence.

HireScope Responsibility: Own append-only domain audit, access logging, trace correlation, report export, and evidence retention.
